Load an ATAC-only experiment from a fragment file

load_atac_fragments.Rd

The cells come from exactly one of barcodes, cellranger or min_fragments; with the last, every barcode with at least that many fragments (outside exclude_chroms), sorted, as Cell Ranger orders them. See barcode_fragment_counts() for the knee plot to pick it from. Pass exactly one of peaks and tile_width.

Usage

load_atac_fragments(
  object,
  fragments,
  peaks = NULL,
  tile_width = NULL,
  chrom_sizes = NULL,
  mode = c("insertion", "paired-insertion", "fragment"),
  barcodes = NULL,
  cellranger = NULL,
  min_fragments = NULL,
  exclude_chroms = c("chrM", "MT", "chrMT", "M"),
  max_mem_gb = NULL,
  .verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

object

SingleCellsAtac class.

fragments

String. The fragment file (BGZF, gzip or plain).

peaks

Optional. A BED file or a data.frame with chrom, start, end.

tile_width

Optional integer. Tile width in bp, instead of peaks.

chrom_sizes

Optional named integer vector of chromosome lengths, for the tiles.

mode

String. What one count is, see add_atac_fragments_sc().

barcodes

Optional character vector. The cell barcodes.

cellranger

Optional string. Cell Ranger ATAC's singlecell.csv or filtered h5.

min_fragments

Optional integer. Call cells with at least this many fragments.

exclude_chroms

Character vector. Chromosomes the min_fragments count skips.

max_mem_gb

Optional numeric. Memory budget of the feature-major conversion.

.verbose

Boolean. Controls verbosity.

Value

The loaded experiment. obs holds cell_id, lib_size, nnz, to_keep; var the features as gene_id (chr:start-end) with chrom, start, end and no_cells_exp.
